Profile.Headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer
Profile.Tagline: I build robust, secure web, mobile and desktop applications — from the public sector to ERP and fintech — with an architect's rigor and a community leader's energy.
About: Senior Java and .NET developer, I have been building web, mobile and desktop applications for more than five years, from the public sector to ERP and fintech. I hold a master's degree in computer security, I am a Microsoft Gold Ambassador and the founder of the .NET Niger community.

Expertises.Title: Full-stack .NET & Java
Expertises.Description: ASP.NET Core, Blazor, WPF, .NET MAUI, Aspire, Spring Boot, Flutter.

Expertises.Title: Cloud & DevOps

Expertises.Title: Application security
Expertises.Description: Master's degree in computer security, transactional reliability, code reviews.

Ambassador.Description: A steady progression through the Microsoft Ambassador program up to the Gold / Senior level: a recognized commitment to knowledge sharing and to growing the tech community.

Community.Description: Founder and organizer of the .NET Niger community: bringing developers together, sharing best practices and promoting the Microsoft ecosystem in Niger.
